lessons.title: Where is the bank?

items.example: Onde fica o banco?
items.exampleMeaning: Where is the bank?

items.example: A escola está perto do banco.
items.exampleMeaning: The school is near the bank.

items.example: Vire à direita na próxima esquina.
items.exampleMeaning: Turn right at the next corner.

items.example: Vire à esquerda na próxima rua.
items.exampleMeaning: Turn left at the next street.

items.example: O restaurante está perto da escola.
items.exampleMeaning: The restaurant is near the school.

items.example: A farmácia está longe do banco.
items.exampleMeaning: The pharmacy is far from the bank.

lessons.tip: In Portuguese, 'direita' means 'right' and 'esquerda' means 'left'. Use these words to give directions.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where is the bank?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: O banco está perto da escola.
dialogue.meaning: The bank is near the school.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And where is the school?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A escola está longe do banco.
dialogue.meaning: The school is far from the bank.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How do I get there?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Vire à direita na próxima esquina.
dialogue.meaning: Turn right at the next corner.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a local person who knows the area.
scenario.learnerRole: B is a tourist asking for directions.
scenario.brief: You are asking A where the bank is and how to get to the school. Use the words for places and directions.
scenario.goal: You need to find out where the bank and the school are.

lessons.title: Finding the restaurant

items.example: O restaurante está na esquina.
items.exampleMeaning: The restaurant is on the corner.

items.example: A farmácia está perto do restaurante.
items.exampleMeaning: The pharmacy is near the restaurant.

items.example: Você pode me dar direções para o restaurante?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you give me directions to the restaurant?

items.example: Siga em frente até a farmácia.
items.exampleMeaning: Follow straight until the pharmacy.

items.example: O restaurante está na próxima esquina.
items.exampleMeaning: The restaurant is at the next corner.

items.example: Vá em frente e vire à esquerda.
items.exampleMeaning: Go straight ahead and turn left.

lessons.tip: Use 'siga' to tell someone to follow a direction. It is often used with 'em frente' for going straight.

lessons.title: Asking about the park

items.example: O parque está longe da escola.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is far from the school.

items.example: A escola fica nesta rua.
items.exampleMeaning: The school is on this street.

items.example: O parque está atrás da escola.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is behind the school.

items.example: A farmácia está na frente do banco.
items.exampleMeaning: The pharmacy is in front of the bank.

items.example: O parque está entre a escola e o banco.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is between the school and the bank.

items.example: A praça está perto do parque.
items.exampleMeaning: The square is near the park.

lessons.tip: Use 'entre' for 'between' when talking about locations. It helps to specify where something is.

lessons.title: Getting to the bus station

items.example: A estação de ônibus está longe do parque.
items.exampleMeaning: The bus station is far from the park.

items.example: Vá direto até a estação de ônibus.
items.exampleMeaning: Go straight to the bus station.

items.example: A parada fica perto da farmácia.
items.exampleMeaning: The stop is near the pharmacy.

items.example: A estação de ônibus está na cidade.
items.exampleMeaning: The bus station is in the city.

items.example: Vire à direita no sinal.
items.exampleMeaning: Turn right at the traffic light.

items.example: Qual é o caminho para a estação de ônibus?
items.exampleMeaning: What is the way to the bus station?

lessons.tip: Use 'direto' for 'straight' when giving directions. It helps to clarify the path.

dialogue.meaning: And the stop?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.meaning: The stop is near the pharmacy.
